messages:
alyssa: quick ping — PR #812 for the client v2 migration guide is ready for review. needs reviewer assignment + docs-preview. cc @mike @jen. small API example changes included.

mike: I can take first pass this morning. is this large?

alyssa: thanks! it's ~10 paragraphs, 2 code snippets, and one link that might be flaky. affects 'client migration' section only. needs at least one reviewer for accuracy + 1 approval for merge.

samir: heads up, I'm in oncall until 2pm PT, might be slow.

jen: I can run the docs preview and sanity check examples. send the PR link.

alyssa: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812 — preview failed on first run, CI job 'docs-preview' errored with 500 on the build server.

dev-docs-bot: CI: docs-preview failed for PR #812 — see logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/BUILD/12345 (error: template renderer crashed).

jen: grabbing logs. looks like a broken relative link in migration.md: `[v1 config](../config/v1.md)` resolves to 404 in preview.

jen: example snippet from log: 
```
Error: File not found: ../config/v1.md referenced in migration.md:42
```

alyssa: ah that's my bad — I updated directories in a follow-up commit locally and forgot to update the link. will push a fix now.

alyssa: pushed fix (sha: b7c9f2a). updated link to `/docs/config/v1.md` and ran `make preview` locally.

deploy-bot: Preview redeploy triggered for PR #812 (sha: b7c9f2a) — status: queued.

jen: preview is up: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-812 — examples render fine, link resolves, formatting nit: code block language for Python missing line highlight.

mike: skimmed — LGTM for content. only comment is we should call out the deprecated param name in a single-line note.

alyssa: added a one-line note and pushed (sha: b7c9f2a -> 4d1e6a3).

samir: I can give the final approve at 2:15pm PT once oncall quiets down. if we want faster merge, @lia is on rotation for docs merges this afternoon.

lia: I can take the merge if both reviewers approve. I'm covering merge window 3-5pm PT.

mike: approved :thumbsup:

jen: one tiny nit about trailing whitespace in example, but not a release blocker. approving after that fix.

alyssa: fixed trailing whitespace and squashed commits (sha: 8f3a1b2). thanks all.

lia: will merge at 15:50 PT (10 minutes before end of window) unless something else pops. tagging in release notes: "client v2 migration guide — doc update and example fix".

alyssa: perfect, adding release note snippet to PR description. thanks everyone :rocket:
